quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.287 [NRS-484B-287-1c, NRS-484B-287-1d, NRS-484B-287-1e, LVMC-11-30-060-A, LVMC-11-30-060-B], 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B] and 484B.350 [LVMC-11-46-030]: Whenever signals exhibiting the words “Walk,” “Don’t Walk,” “Wait” or similar symbols are in place, such signals indicate as follows: While the “Walk” indication or walking person symbol is illuminated, pedestrians facing the signal may proceed across the highway in the direction of the signal and must be given the right-of-way by the drivers of all vehicles.

activation.condition: official Walk indication illuminated for a pedestrian facing the signal and proceeding in its direction

obligation.description: drivers of all vehicles give the pedestrian right-of-way
obligation.source_clause: the right-of-way by the drivers of all vehicles.

exceptions.trigger: cited NRS 484B.287, 484B.290 or 484B.350 may govern the scene
exceptions.replacement_obligation: unresolved until the cited provision and original scene are reviewed

timing.description: while the Walk indication or walking person symbol is illuminated

judgment_calls_needed.note: Driver response is descriptive until original pedestrian-facing Walk, crossing, governing control and cited exceptions are reviewed.
